description: This file defines a controller class for managing the free shipping extension in the OpenCart admin interface. It handles displaying the configuration form and saving settings related to free shipping, including breadcrumbs, form data, permissions check, and view rendering.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: Controller class for managing free shipping extension in OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, gathers configuration parameters, loads header, column, footer, and renders the view for the free shipping settings page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the free shipping extension settings, checks user permissions, updates settings if permitted, and returns a JSON response.
